selection: Largest byte-size revision per Git discovery path, ties by object ID, within frozen manifest. Complete marker search inside each chosen text; at most twelve lines/2600 characters per context.
limits: Attribution markers are not authentication of original chats.
Five may occur only elsewhere in a source; such contexts are separately flagged.
Largest revision is not necessarily the current or corrected one.
All-revision catalog remains separate; this pass does not search every line of every revision for prompt markers.
